9c2affe0:  ;
 ;Determine the status of a TIU document based on the completion of
 ;certain fields related to signing, reviewing, and dictating/transcribing.
 ;Primarily looks at DGJTNDT (TIU Document Notes multiple) and
 ;DGJTDEL (Dictation Status field).
01b13327: If the TIU document is incomplete and not reviewed, set status to 'INCOMPLETE'
28c41a9c: If the TIU document is incomplete but reviewed, set status to 'REVIEWED'
7ae4891c: If the TIU document is incomplete, signed, but not reviewed and not electronically delivered, set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW'
478a407c: If the TIU document is incomplete, signed, but not reviewed and electronically delivered, set status to 'SIGNED'
fa5f6172: If the TIU document has no dictated date/time, set status to 'INCOMPLETE'
e6d6bb86: If the TIU document has no dictated by (author) set status to 'DICTATED'
5729faec: If the TIU document has no transcribed date/time, set status to 'TRANSCRIBED'
b8a32b27: If the TIU document is signed but not reviewed and not electronically delivered, set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW'
ed1cd8d5: If the TIU document is signed but not reviewed, set status to 'SIGNED'
39656c88: If the TIU document is signed and reviewed, set status to 'REVIEWED'
